Hi Lydia — thanks for sending these over and for the call earlier. Quick responses and next steps: 

1) Bank proof: the attached bank letter is fine; for our risk team we need account numbers masked in the copy we keep on file (we'll store the full copy in our secure vault). If you can resend a redacted version for vendor portal display that would be great, otherwise we'll redact on upload.

2) PO / remittance mapping: our Payments team needs a single stable field for invoice-to-PO matching. Can you confirm whether you will populate the PO into the invoice header as PO_NUMBER, or include PO in the "remit_reference"? Example we use on Redwood side: "invoice.po_number" or "remit_reference" — any of these works but we need consistency.

3) Micro-deposit: either works for us. If you send micro-deposits, please reply with the two amounts (we'll confirm). If you prefer bank letter only, we'll mark the vendor as verified once we get the redacted doc.

I copied Marissa (Finance Ops) to kick off PO routing and Jordan (Procurement) for the vendor record. Marissa, can you add Clearcade to the payee queue and share the remit label samples we use?

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Vendor Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
